pages.title: Terms and Conditions
pages.intro: These terms cover Maharani Traders’ current own-stock wholesale and retail sales.
pages.meta_description: The basic rules for using the website, placing orders and paying.

sections.heading: Acceptance and business model
body: By using the website, creating an account, placing an order or purchasing products, you agree to these terms and the applicable website policies. If you do not agree, please do not use the website.

Maharani Traders is a customer-facing brand operated by AJAY KUMAR, Proprietor, under the registered trade name AJAY GENERAL; it is not a separate incorporated company or legal entity. These policies cover own-stock cosmetics, personal-care products and non-food FMCG. Food products are excluded.

Maharani Traders sells only goods from its own stock. There is no marketplace: all products are bought, stored, priced and sold by Maharani Traders, and we are the seller of record for every order. The third-party seller programme that earlier versions of these terms mentioned has been discontinued. Any order placed before that change is unaffected, and any rights you already hold are not excluded.

sections.heading: Product information, prices and taxes
body: We endeavour to display accurate product names, descriptions, photographs, prices and quantities. Packaging, colour and other visual details may vary. Please check the actual label, ingredients, directions, warnings, manufacturer details and expiry or use-before information before use.

Prices, applicable taxes, any delivery or compulsory charges, and applicable wholesale quantities, slabs or minimum orders will be displayed or communicated before confirmation. GST will be charged and invoiced as required by law. An obvious listing or pricing error may be corrected before order acceptance; if an amount was collected for an unfulfilled order, it will be refunded.

sections.heading: Order placement and acceptance
body: An order is a request to purchase, subject to stock availability, delivery serviceability and confirmation. We may contact you to verify the order, quantity, address or phone number.

An order may be declined or cancelled if the product is unavailable, the address is outside the serviceable area, information is incomplete or appears fraudulent, the listing contains a material error, or fulfilment would violate applicable law. Amounts collected for an unfulfilled cancelled order will be refunded.

sections.heading: Payment and customer responsibilities
body: The current cash payment method is Cash on Delivery (COD). The checkout may apply an available Coins balance automatically; the remaining confirmed amount is payable to an authorised delivery representative on delivery. Review the checkout total before confirming.

Provide accurate contact and delivery information, check your order, keep account credentials confidential, use the site lawfully and pay the confirmed COD balance when accepting delivery. Do not send money to an unknown personal account or unauthorised payment link. Additional payment methods, if introduced, will be displayed before use.

sections.heading: Intellectual property and applicable law
body: The Maharani Traders name, original site design, logos, text and graphics may not be reproduced or commercially used without permission except as permitted by law. Third-party product names and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

Nothing in these terms excludes a right or remedy that cannot lawfully be excluded. Indian law applies; disputes may be handled by the competent authority or court having jurisdiction under applicable law. See our [cancellation and return policy](/legal/returns) and [contact details](/contact).

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.intro: This policy describes website privacy practices and contacts; all uses, including any marketplace processing, require verification before publication.
pages.meta_description: What personal data we collect, why, who sees it, and how to ask for access, correction or deletion.

sections.heading: Information we may collect
body: Depending on your use, we may collect your name, mobile number, email, billing and delivery addresses, order and purchase history, COD collection and payment status, support messages and complaints, account, login and device-related information, and information needed for tax, accounting, security, fraud prevention or legal compliance.
Do not send passwords, OTPs or unnecessary sensitive personal information through customer support.

sections.heading: How information is used and shared
body: Information may be used to manage accounts, confirm and deliver orders, communicate about orders and returns, maintain invoices and tax records, handle support and refunds, detect fraud and misuse, improve the website and comply with applicable law. Unrelated uses require an appropriate lawful basis.

Where necessary and lawful, information may be shared with delivery providers, technology and security providers, professional advisers or authorities. Because every order is fulfilled by Maharani Traders from its own stock, order and delivery information is not disclosed to any independent seller or marketplace participant; that programme has been discontinued. We do not sell customer personal information as a business practice. The application uses Supabase for authentication and includes Vercel Analytics; actual deployment and provider arrangements should be verified before publication.

sections.heading: Cookies and security
body: The site may use cookies or similar technologies for login, cart functionality, security, preferences and performance. Any legally required consent mechanism must be implemented and verified before publication. Browser settings can control cookies, but disabling essential cookies may affect functionality.

Reasonable technical and organisational measures are intended to protect information, but no internet service can guarantee absolute security. Use strong passwords and do not share OTPs or login credentials.

sections.heading: Retention, requests and updates
body: Information may be retained for fulfilment, accounting, tax, complaint handling, disputes and legal compliance. Retention periods and deletion procedures require verification; some transaction or tax records may need statutory retention.

For questions, corrections or other privacy requests, contact AJAY KUMAR, Proprietor, using the details below. Requests will be reviewed under applicable law. This policy may be updated when practices or requirements change; the latest version will carry its effective date.

pages.title: Cancellation, Return and Refund Policy
pages.intro: Contact us as soon as reasonably possible about a cancellation or product issue.
pages.meta_description: When an order can be cancelled, how refunds work and what happens to Coins.

sections.heading: Order cancellation
body: Contact us as soon as possible to request cancellation. A request before dispatch may be accepted; an order already dispatched may not be cancellable through the ordinary process. Cancellation depends on order status and applicable law. If we cancel an order after collecting payment, the amount paid for the unfulfilled order will be refunded.

sections.heading: Product issues and return requests
body: Contact us if a product is damaged, defective, wrong, a wrong quantity, materially different from its description, suspected spurious or non-genuine, or has a relevant labelling, quality or legal issue. We will review the complaint and provide the remedy required by applicable law, which may include replacement, return, refund or another appropriate remedy.

Please provide your order number, name and mobile number, product and quantity, issue description and photographs or video if reasonably available. We may ask for additional information; a missing photograph alone does not automatically remove statutory rights.
The website return-request form may have an order-specific deadline. If the form is closed, contact support; an internal deadline does not remove statutory rights or remedies.

sections.heading: Cosmetics, hygiene and refunds
body: A change-of-mind return for opened or used cosmetics may be refused for hygiene and safety where lawful. This does not prevent a legally available remedy for a defective, damaged, wrong, spurious or misdescribed product.

For an approved COD refund, support will arrange a reasonable and lawful refund method and verify necessary details. We will communicate an expected processing time after approval. Never share an OTP, password or card PIN to obtain a refund. No unverified blanket return period or automatic refund is promised.
Nothing in this policy limits rights or remedies available under applicable consumer-protection or other Indian law.

pages.title: Shipping and Delivery Policy
pages.intro: Delivery is limited to local serviceable areas in and around Belaganj, Gaya, Bihar.
pages.meta_description: Where we deliver, delivery OTP, and what to check at the door.

sections.heading: Serviceability, charges and estimates
body: Delivery is available only when the address is confirmed as serviceable by the website or support. Not all Gaya PINs are serviceable; we do not promise delivery throughout Gaya district or Bihar. An active serviceable PIN and applicable minimum order are checked at checkout.

Delivery or other compulsory charges will be disclosed before confirmation. If no charge is shown, confirm it with support before placing an order. The current checkout blocks online ordering for PINs configured with a positive delivery fee until that fee can be accounted for correctly.

Estimated timing will be communicated at checkout or confirmation, depending on availability and location. Estimates can be affected by weather, local conditions or operational issues. Contact support about significant delays; order status is not real-time location tracking.

sections.heading: Address and delivery inspection
body: Provide an accurate address and reachable phone number. You or your authorised recipient should be available to receive the order and pay the confirmed COD balance. Support may contact you if the address is incorrect, the recipient is unavailable or the order is refused.

Check the package and quantity at delivery. Report visible damage to the representative and contact support promptly. This does not affect statutory rights concerning defective, damaged, wrong, spurious or misdescribed products.

pages.title: Return, Replacement and Damaged Goods Procedure
pages.intro: What to do when goods arrive damaged, short, wrong, expired or not as described. This procedure works together with the Cancellation, Return and Refund Policy.
pages.meta_description: Step-by-step procedure for damaged, short, wrong or expired goods.

sections.heading: Check the goods at delivery
body: Delivery is completed with a one-time password (OTP) that only you receive. Please count and inspect the goods before you share the OTP with the delivery person.

If any item is missing or visibly damaged, tell the delivery person before the delivery is completed. They record the missing or damaged quantity against each item, and the delivery is saved as a partial delivery.

sections.heading: What happens for a shortfall recorded at the door
body: You pay only for the goods actually delivered. The amount to collect is recalculated from the quantities recorded.

If Coins were applied to goods that were not delivered, the value of that shortfall is credited back to your Coins balance. The system calculates this amount from the recorded quantities; it cannot be typed in by the delivery person.

sections.heading: Problems found after delivery
body: Raise a return request from the order page, or contact us using the details below. Each delivered order shows the last date for raising a return request in the app. If that date has passed, you can still contact us: an internal deadline does not take away a remedy the law gives you.

Tell us the order number, the product, the quantity affected and what is wrong. Photographs of the product, the batch number and the outer carton help us act quickly and trace the batch. A missing photograph does not by itself defeat a valid complaint.
bullets: Damaged in transit or leaking.
Wrong product, wrong variant or wrong quantity.
Expired, or past its “use before” date when delivered.
Seal broken, label missing or label does not match the listing.
Suspected counterfeit or not genuine.

sections.heading: How we resolve it
body: After checking the complaint we will offer the remedy that fits the problem: replacement, collection of the goods with a refund, or a price adjustment. Every order on this website is sold and fulfilled by Maharani Traders from its own stock, so we handle the whole complaint ourselves and there is no third party to pass it to. See the [Marketplace Disclaimer](/legal/marketplace-disclaimer) for the record of the discontinued marketplace programme.
Please keep the product, its packaging and the invoice until the complaint is closed. Do not use or resell a product you believe is unsafe or not genuine.

Opened or used cosmetics and personal-care products are not accepted back for a change of mind, for hygiene reasons. This does not apply where the product is defective, damaged, wrong, expired or not genuine.

pages.title: Seller Agreement
pages.intro: The agreement between Maharani Traders (the marketplace operator) and each independent seller who lists goods on this website. A seller must accept the current version before any offer can go live.
pages.meta_description: Duties of third-party sellers: registration, genuine goods, labelling, fulfilment, taxes and payouts.

sections.heading: Who can sell
body: Selling is by invitation only. A seller account is created only from an invitation issued by the Super Admin. There is no public seller sign-up.

Before the account is activated the seller must provide true and current business details and documents for verification, including legal name, business address, GST registration details and PAN where applicable, and bank account details for payouts. The seller must tell us promptly if any of these change.
We may refuse, pause or end onboarding if details cannot be verified.

sections.heading: What can be listed
body: Only cosmetics, personal-care and non-food FMCG goods in categories that we have approved may be listed. Food and drink of every kind are not permitted on this website. See the Prohibited and Restricted Products Policy.
Every offer is reviewed before it is shown to buyers. We keep a record of each approval, rejection and suspension and the reason for it.

sections.heading: Seller’s promises about the goods
bullets: The goods are genuine, lawfully sourced and the seller has the right to sell them.
Cosmetics are made by a licensed manufacturer or lawfully imported, and carry the label particulars required by the Cosmetics Rules, 2020.

Pre-packaged goods carry the declarations required by the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, including MRP, net quantity, month and year of manufacture or packing, manufacturer or importer details, consumer-care details and, for imported goods, country of origin.
Goods are not expired, recalled, tampered with or re-labelled, and have a reasonable remaining shelf life when dispatched.
The description, images, price and stock shown on the listing are accurate and are kept up to date.
The seller will give us invoices, licences, test reports or brand authorisations when we ask for them to check a listing or a complaint.

sections.heading: Orders, delivery and returns
body: The seller must make the ordered goods ready in the quantity and condition ordered. If the seller cannot fulfil an order it must tell us at once so the buyer can be informed.

The seller is responsible for the goods it sells and must accept back, replace or refund goods that are damaged, defective, wrong, expired, not genuine or not as described, in line with the policies published on this website and with the law.
The seller must name a person who will respond to buyer complaints that we forward, and must respond within the timelines in the Grievance Redressal Policy.

sections.heading: Prices, taxes, fees and payouts
body: The seller sets its selling price, which must not exceed the MRP printed on the pack. The seller is the supplier of its goods for GST purposes and is responsible for its own tax invoices, returns and tax payments.

Our commission or fees, and the payout cycle, are those agreed with the seller in writing and recorded against the seller account. Payouts are made after deducting agreed fees, refunds, and any tax that the law requires us to collect or deduct on the seller’s sales, and are shown in the seller ledger.
We may hold a payout for an order that is the subject of an open complaint, return or investigation until it is resolved.

sections.heading: Buyer data
body: The seller receives only the buyer information needed to fulfil an order. It must be used only for that order, kept secure, and not used for marketing or shared with anyone else.

sections.heading: Suspension and ending the agreement
body: We may remove a listing or suspend a seller where there is a safety concern, a suspected counterfeit, a breach of this agreement or of the law, or a failure to respond to complaints. When a seller is suspended its offers are withdrawn from sale automatically.

Either side may end the agreement by written notice. Orders already accepted, complaints, returns, payouts due and record-keeping duties continue until they are completed. See the Suspension, Termination and Dispute Policy.

sections.heading: Changes to this agreement
body: When this agreement changes we publish a new version with a new version number and date. A seller is asked to accept the new version; the version accepted and the time of acceptance are recorded.

Whether the operator has registered for, and will collect, tax at source on seller sales under section 52 of the CGST Act, and deduct tax under section 194-O of the Income-tax Act. Confirm with a Chartered Accountant before the first third-party sale.

pages.title: Retailer and Wholesale Buyer Terms
pages.intro: Additional terms for shops and wholesale buyers. They apply together with the general Terms and Conditions.
pages.meta_description: Extra terms for shops buying for resale: account approval, pricing category, resale duties.

sections.heading: Who can buy
body: This website serves retailers and wholesale buyers in the areas we deliver to. An account is reviewed before it can place orders. Please give true shop details, including the shop name, address, mobile number and, if you are registered, your GSTIN.
You are responsible for orders placed from your account. Keep your password private and tell us at once if you think someone else has used your account.

sections.heading: Prices and your pricing category
body: Prices, pack sizes, minimum quantities and any quantity slabs are shown before you confirm an order. The price that applies is the one shown at checkout for your account.

Your account may be placed in a pricing category by our team. A category is not a paid membership: there is no fee, no subscription and no renewal. We may change a category, and the change applies to orders placed after it.

sections.heading: Payment
body: Orders are paid by Cash on Delivery. Any Coins balance applied is shown at checkout, and the remaining amount is payable to our delivery person when you accept the goods. Pay only against the order shown in the app, and never share your delivery OTP before you have checked the goods.

sections.heading: Resale
bullets: Sell the goods in their original, unopened packs, with the label intact.
Do not sell above the MRP printed on the pack.
Do not sell goods after the “use before” or expiry date. Store goods as the label directs.
If we tell you about a recall or a safety problem with a batch, stop selling it and follow our instructions.

sections.heading: Your rights as a business buyer
body: Some consumer-protection laws apply only to people who buy for personal use and may not apply to goods bought for resale. Whatever the legal position, the complaint, return and grievance procedures published on this website are open to every buyer.

pages.title: Marketplace Disclaimer
pages.intro: This website sells goods from our own stock and can also show offers from independent sellers. This page explains the difference.
pages.meta_description: Which goods are sold by us and which by independent sellers, and who is responsible for what.

sections.heading: Two kinds of offer
body: Own stock: goods bought, stored and sold by Maharani Traders. We are the seller and issue the invoice.

Seller offer: goods offered by an independent seller that we have invited and verified. That seller is the seller of those goods and is responsible for their quality, labelling, authenticity and tax invoice. The offer shows the seller’s name.

sections.heading: What we do for seller offers
bullets: Invite sellers individually and check their business details before they can list.
Review each offer before it is shown, and allow only approved cosmetics and non-food FMCG categories.
Take a written agreement from each seller that goods are genuine and correctly labelled.
Receive your complaints, forward them to the seller, and follow them up to a conclusion.
Remove listings and suspend sellers where we find a problem.

sections.heading: What we do not do
body: We do not manufacture any product sold here. We do not make any health, medical or treatment claim for any product. Product descriptions and images for seller offers come from the seller; always read the label on the pack before using or reselling a product.
This page does not limit any liability that the law places on a marketplace operator or on a seller, and it does not limit your right to complain to us about any order placed on this website.

pages.title: GST, Pricing and Invoice Policy
pages.intro: How prices and taxes are shown on this website and what invoice you receive.
pages.meta_description: How prices and taxes are shown, and when a tax invoice is issued.

sections.heading: Prices
body: The price for each product, the pack size and the quantity are shown before you place an order, and the order summary shows the total payable. Any delivery or other charge is shown separately before you confirm.
No product is sold above the Maximum Retail Price (MRP) printed on its pack. If a pack you receive shows a lower MRP than the price charged, tell us and we will correct it.
If a price was shown wrongly because of an obvious error, we will contact you before dispatch and you may cancel the order without any charge.

sections.heading: GST
body: Where GST applies, it is charged at the rate that applies to the product and is shown in the order summary and on the invoice.

If you want your GSTIN on the invoice, add the correct GSTIN and registered business name to your account before placing the order. We cannot add or change a GSTIN on an invoice that has already been issued, except as the GST law allows.

sections.heading: Invoices
body: An invoice or bill is issued for every delivered order by Maharani Traders, which sells only from its own stock and is therefore the seller of record. Because there is no marketplace, an order never contains goods supplied by another seller and you will not receive a second invoice from a third party.
The app shows a tax invoice only when the registration and tax details needed for a valid tax invoice are complete. Until then the document is marked as an order summary and is not a tax invoice.
For returns and price corrections, a credit note or revised document is issued as the GST law requires.

pages.title: Prohibited and Restricted Products Policy
pages.intro: This website is for cosmetics, personal-care and non-food FMCG goods only. The following may never be listed, whether by us or by a seller.
pages.meta_description: What may never be listed here — including all food products.

sections.heading: Never allowed
bullets: Food and drink of any kind, including packaged food, snacks, beverages, baby food, edible oils, spices, confectionery, pan masala and health or nutrition supplements.
Medicines and drugs, including anything that needs a prescription, and products that claim to prevent, treat or cure a disease.
Tobacco, nicotine, e-cigarettes, alcohol and intoxicants.
Counterfeit, replica, smuggled or stolen goods, and goods sold without the brand owner’s authority where that is required.
Cosmetics that are not made by a licensed manufacturer or not lawfully imported, or that contain an ingredient that is not permitted.
Expired, recalled, tampered, re-labelled, repacked or tester/“not for sale” goods.
Goods without the label declarations required by law, or with an altered MRP.
Hazardous, flammable or dangerous goods that cannot be carried safely, and any goods whose sale is prohibited by law.

sections.heading: How this is enforced
body: Every product category carries a compliance classification set by the Super Admin. Only categories classified as cosmetics or non-food FMCG can hold products for sale; the database rejects a product placed in any other category.

Every product goes through a compliance review before it can be published, and each decision is recorded with the reviewer and the reason. Only Maharani Traders adds products to this website, so there is no third-party listing channel to police.

sections.heading: Report a listing
body: If you see a product here that you believe is prohibited, unsafe or not genuine, tell us using the contact details below. We will review it, and remove it from sale while we check where there is a safety concern.

pages.title: Intellectual Property Complaints Policy
pages.intro: For brand owners and their authorised agents who believe a listing on this website infringes a trade mark, copyright or design, or is counterfeit.
pages.meta_description: How a brand owner can report a counterfeit or infringing listing.

sections.heading: What to send us
bullets: Your name, organisation, address, phone number and email.
The right you rely on (for example the registered trade mark and its registration number) and proof that you own it or are authorised to act.
The exact listing: the product name as shown and the page link.
Why you believe it infringes or is counterfeit.
A statement that the information is true and that you are the owner or authorised by the owner.

sections.heading: What we do
body: We acknowledge the complaint, check it, and where it appears valid we remove or disable the listing while we investigate. Because we are the seller of every product on this website, there is no third-party seller to notify: we answer the complaint ourselves with the purchase invoices and brand authorisations we hold.
If our own records show the goods are genuine and lawfully sold, the listing may be restored and we will tell you why. A listing that cannot be substantiated stays withdrawn.
We keep a record of each complaint and its outcome. Complaints that are knowingly false may be rejected and may lead to restriction of the complainant’s account.

sections.heading: Our own content
body: Product names, logos and pack images shown on this website belong to their respective owners and are used only to identify the goods offered for sale.

pages.title: Suspension, Termination and Dispute Policy
pages.intro: When an account can be restricted or closed, and how a decision or dispute is handled. It applies to buyers and sellers.
pages.meta_description: When an account can be restricted or closed, and how to dispute it.

sections.heading: When we may restrict or close an account
bullets: False or unverifiable registration details or documents.
Fraud, misuse of Coins, coupons or offers, or attempts to interfere with the website or other accounts.
Repeated refusal of delivered orders or non-payment of Cash on Delivery orders without a valid reason.
Abuse or threats towards our staff, delivery persons or other users.
For retailer accounts: attempted resale of unsafe, counterfeit, mislabelled or prohibited goods, or failure to respond to complaints about an order.
Where the law or an order of a court or authority requires it.

sections.heading: How we do it
body: Where it is safe to do so we tell you the reason and give you a chance to explain before a lasting restriction. Where there is a risk to buyers, to payments or to the security of the service, we may act first and tell you afterwards.
Restriction decisions are recorded with the reason and the person who made them.

sections.heading: Closing your own account
body: A retailer can ask for account closure from Account → Security in the app, or by contacting us. Open orders, returns and amounts due are settled first.

After closure we delete or anonymise personal data that we no longer need, and keep only what the law requires us to keep, such as invoices and tax and accounting records, for the period the law requires. See the Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: What continues after closure or suspension
body: Orders already delivered, complaints, returns, refunds due to you and payments due from you are not cancelled by a suspension or closure. A Coins balance that represents money refunded to you remains yours; ask us how it will be returned.

sections.heading: Disputes
body: Start with the Grievance Redressal Policy: most problems are settled there. If you are not satisfied with the outcome you may ask for it to be reviewed by the proprietor.
These policies are governed by the laws of India. Nothing here stops you from approaching a consumer commission, court or authority that has jurisdiction under the law.

owner_decisions: How a remaining Coins balance is paid out when an account is closed.
Whether disputes with sellers go to arbitration or to court, and the place — to be drafted by a lawyer.

pages.title: Cookie and Device Storage Notice
pages.intro: This website stores a small amount of information on your device so that it can work. It does not use advertising cookies.
pages.meta_description: The small files this website stores on your device and why.

sections.heading: What is stored and why
bullets: Sign-in session cookies: keep you signed in securely and protect your account. They are necessary; the website cannot work without them.

Device storage for convenience: recently viewed products, recent searches, your product-comparison list and whether you dismissed a notice. This stays on your device and is not used to build an advertising profile.
Offline app files: if you install the website as an app, your browser keeps copies of app files so pages load faster.

sections.heading: Usage statistics
body: We use Vercel Web Analytics to count page visits so that we can keep the website working well. According to its provider it does not use cookies and does not identify individual visitors. We do not use it for advertising.

sections.heading: What we do not use
body: No advertising cookies, no social-media tracking pixels and no sale of browsing data. If that ever changes, this notice will be updated first and, where the law requires consent, you will be asked before anything is stored.

sections.heading: Your choices
body: You can clear cookies and site data in your browser settings at any time. Clearing them signs you out and removes your recently viewed list. Blocking necessary cookies will stop sign-in from working.

pages.title: Coins and Loyalty Points Terms
pages.intro: Coins and loyalty points are two separate records on a retailer account. This page explains each. There is no paid membership on this website.
pages.meta_description: How Coins and loyalty points are added, used, reversed and corrected.

sections.heading: Coins
body: Coins are a balance on your account. Coins are added when we credit a refund or adjustment to you, for example for goods that were short or damaged at delivery, or for a cancelled order on which Coins had been used.
At checkout the available Coins balance may be applied to the order automatically, and the amount applied is shown before you confirm. The rest is paid by Cash on Delivery.
If an order is cancelled or returned, Coins used on it are credited back. Each credit is recorded once against the order or delivery, so the same refund cannot be credited twice.
Every Coins entry appears in your account ledger with its date and reason.

sections.heading: Loyalty points
body: Loyalty points are added automatically when an order is delivered: 1 point for every full ₹100 of the order. If the order is later returned, the points for it are removed.

Points are a record of your buying activity. They are not money, they have no cash value, they cannot be transferred, and at present they cannot be redeemed against an order. If a redemption scheme is introduced, its terms will be published here first.
Points are only ever added by the system on a verified delivery, or adjusted by an Admin with a recorded reason.

sections.heading: Corrections and misuse
body: If you think a Coins or points entry is wrong, contact us with the order number. We will check it against the ledger and correct a genuine error.
We may reverse Coins or points that were credited by mistake or obtained by fraud or misuse, and will record the reason for doing so.

owner_decisions: Whether Coins ever expire (the software sets no expiry; none is stated here).
Whether loyalty points will become redeemable, and on what terms.

pages.title: Wholesale, with clearer choices
pages.intro: Maharani Traders is the brand of AJAY KUMAR, Proprietor, trading as AJAY GENERAL. The current policy scope is own-stock wholesale and retail trading of cosmetics and non-food FMCG.
pages.meta_description: Maharani Traders is the brand of AJAY KUMAR, Proprietor, trading as AJAY GENERAL. The current policy scope is own-stock wholesale and retail trading of cosmetics and non-food FMCG.

sections.heading: How ordering works
body: Approved retailer accounts can maintain a cart and choose a saved delivery address. The order service rechecks product availability, pricing, GST, applicable offers, available Coins and the address at checkout. A pending order is not a delivery guarantee.

Maharani Traders sells only from its own stock, so every order is fulfilled and invoiced by Maharani Traders. The third-party marketplace described in earlier versions of this page has been discontinued. Food products are excluded from the current scope.

sections.heading: Where can we deliver?
body: Gaya, Bihar is the initial configuration default, not blanket coverage. A retailer can order online only to an active, individually verified district/state/PIN combination. Delivery availability is checked again when an order is placed. [Read delivery details](/legal/shipping).

sections.heading: Identity and trust
body: Owner-provided business and contact details are available for review; GST and other statutory invoice information must be verified before publication. See the [contact options](/contact) or sign in to raise a support ticket.
